text:
Maya H: Quick idea — Mini Snack Swap + Retro Pixel Arcade night next Friday 7pm? Thinking rent a couple of cabinets at The Joystick (short walk from office), bring a snack to share (label allergies), and do a tiny mocktail contest (non-alc only) :tada:
Devin: love it. 7pm works for me. how much to rent the cabinets? :thinking_face:
Samir: usually ~ $120/hour for two cabinets if we do a 2-hr block. we could ask finance to cover or split. i can volunteer to ping the venue tomorrow. :raised_hands:
Keiko: i'm vegetarian — can we add a note about dietary labels on the sign-up? also can we make it low-friction for people to RSVP (sheet or emoji)? :leafy_green:
Alex: emoji RSVP looks easiest. :+1: i'll make a quick sign-up sheet for snacks and mocktails. adding a column for allergies and whether someone can help carry cabinets if needed.
Maya H: awesome. if people react with :thumbsup: we'll count as yes. if you can help with funds, react with :moneybag: and i'll follow up with finance.
Devin: :thumbsup: — i can chip in if we need to split. happy to help set up on site too.
Samir: booked a tentative hold with Joystick for Fri 7–9pm. they want a deposit. i'll post the exact total after they confirm cabinet availability.
Keiko: :thumbsup: also can we make it family-friendly? a few folks might bring partners.
Alex: added sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AbC-EXAMPLE (column A: name, B: snack, C: mocktail, D: allergies, E: can-help-transport) — paste this in thread so people can sign.
Maya H: cool — i'll drop an invite to #general tomorrow. for now tagging folks: @design, @eng, @product — small, casual, drop-in friendly.
calendar-bot: Event "Snack Swap + Pixel Arcade" created on Fri from 19:00 to 21:00. RSVP set to optional. Location: The Joystick, 2 blocks from HQ.
Devin: also, if anyone has a small portable speaker or extension cords, please mark the sheet.
Samir: noted. i'll bring tools and a dolly just in case. :wrench:
Keiko: can someone volunteer to make a little sign about labeling with allergens? i can print it during lunch on Fri if someone drafts the text.
Alex: I put a sample label text in the sheet (row 2). simple: "Contains: nuts / dairy / gluten / vegan" and "Prepared by: name".
Maya H: perfect. final ask — can people react with :thumbsup: in next 48h if they're planning to come so we can finalize deposit tonight? thanks y'all! :sparkles:
